fields.name: Project Description
fields.value:
Moo-Moo is a Qoder-built, deterministic SPY/QQQ paper-trading agent. Ten technical rules vote on each five-minute bar; trades require two agreements and fewer than two oppositions. Entries use $20,000 lots within a $100,000 book, a $40,000/39.5%-of-NAV name cap, no leverage, a 2.5% daily lock, 4% reduced sizing and a 7% drawdown halt. Longs are never sold at a loss; IVV/QQQM provide twin-ETF shorts and are covered by the close, lock or halt.

Orders are persisted as intent, acknowledgement and outcome, then reconciled against Moomoo. The package includes the deck, PDF, runnable source, strategy/risk rules, exit/parity research, tests, equity/drawdown curves, redacted trade/decision logs, dashboard captures, and a worked/failed/why demo.

Qoder Desktop built the system, tests, dashboard, report and deck. Read-only Cloud roles and independent Windows/local Qoder audits are documented with their limits; unavailable Cloud outputs are not claimed. Paper results do not predict live returns.
